name: Left of Center
source:
Garrett Emmett is your a-bit-higher-than-average Sophomore in high school, but with his migraines only getting worse as he gets older, he decides to transfer to a "more organized and disciplined" private school. However, thanks to a mix-up in paper work, Garrett finds himself at Outre Academy, the wrong school, at the turn of the spring semester; it wouldn't be so bad if everyone wasn't half-crazy and bending the conventional rules left and right. But hey! At least things are exciting around here.
He takes a week to figure out whether he wants to stay at this school or not. A lot can happen during that time, you know.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20120&hilit=left+of+center]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
加勒特·埃米特是一个略高于平均水平的高中二年级学生，但随着年龄增长，偏头痛越来越严重，他决定转学到一所“更有组织和纪律”的私立学校。然而，由于文件的混乱，加勒特在春季学期开始时来到了错误的学校——特立学院；如果不是所有人都半疯半狂地左右突破常规规则，这也不会太糟糕。但嘿！至少这里很刺激。
他花了一周时间来决定是否要留在这所学校。在那段时间里，很多事情都可能发生，你知道的。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20120&hilit=left+of+center]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
